caption: One path, /mnt/usb/note.txt, is resolved through the mount table. After /dev/sdb1 is mounted it returns USB inode 77; before the mount it returned local inode 101, which is now hidden but still open to any process that opened it earlier.

spec.title: Mount lookup
spec.aria: A lookup of /mnt/usb/note.txt goes through the mount table: before mounting /dev/sdb1 it reached hidden local inode 101, and after mounting it reaches USB inode 77.
